title: First arrived in Xi'an
summary: From a code novice to pursuing the road of technology
markdown:
Hello everyone, I am a developer with three years of work experience. From the initial code novice to today's technical expert, I have been living very smoothly. However, when I came to Xi'an in June this year with a bright vision for the future, I didn't expect that the ups and downs had just begun.
I interviewed with many companies but couldn't get through. Either because my theoretical foundation was not solid enough, the salary offered by the company could not meet my requirements; or I simply did not receive any response. This depressed me for several days. I couldn't help but reflect on it. In my previous company, I could develop both web applications and mobile applications, and I could quickly get started with new technologies. Why can't I even find a job now? It’s really an indescribable feeling of loss…
There is a saying that is very true: "Behind every successful man there is a great woman." I completely believe this sentence. When I was at my lowest, my girlfriend Huihui always guided me. She told me that if you give up, you will get something, and there will always be ups and downs in life. Now, what I need is to supplement my basic knowledge and gain a deep understanding of the core ideas of programming through basic knowledge. It's time to learn again! Really learn, understand technology, and embrace technology!
Here, I would like to thank those interviewers who rejected me, precisely because you gave me the opportunity to get to know myself again. At the same time, I would also like to thank my girlfriend Hui Hui for always supporting and encouraging me when I was most helpless.
Next, I will record my learning and growth journey in the form of a blog. I hope that by sharing my experiences and insights, I can bring some help and inspiration to other developers who have similar experiences. At the same time, I also hope that through this process, I can have a deeper understanding of technology and grow together with developers.
Let us start again and pursue the road of technology!
